inv.desc_en:
TECNOCASA real estate agency in the BARRIO DEL PILAR - LA VAGUADA - GINZO DE LIMIA area, RENTS commercial premises located on a main street.

2-story commercial premises, located at street level, next to the Barrio del Pilar metro station and La Vaguada Shopping Center.

Unbeatable location on a main street with high foot traffic.

It has two floors (main floor and customer service floor), a restroom, and a storefront window.

LAST BUSINESS: REAL ESTATE AGENCY

- Book your visit -

OVER 30 YEARS OF EXPERIENCE BACK US UP!
